reply.text:
I can't give you an amount for ashwagandha, or for any supplement. Dosing is a call for a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can look at your health, any medications you take, and whether it makes sense for you at all.

As general context, the research on ashwagandha and testosterone is small and mixed, and supplement quality varies a lot from brand to brand. If you want to get your testosterone checked or see what a supplement might do for you, a doctor is the right person for that.

What moves the needle from my side is the unglamorous stuff: sleep, eating enough, heavy compound lifts with progressive overload, and managing stress. I'm happy to look at any of those in your training.
